environment: n8n 2.45.7 (n8n start, isolated user folder) + mock Jira Cloud + SMTP sink

results.name: Happy path: two active sprints, paginated Jira, digest emailed
results.expected: Both sprints sent; Payments=Critical 29% (3 blocked, 2 stale, 2 overdue, 2 unassigned, Priya overloaded); Mobile=Healthy; 10 Jira calls incl. 3 board pages and 4 search pages
results.actual: HTTP 200; sent=2; Payments Critical 29% blocked=3 stale=2 overdue=2 unassigned=2 overloaded=Priya Raman; Jira calls=10 (sprint-11 pages=4); emails=2; rows=sent,sent

results.name: Same-day re-run is deduplicated
results.expected: Second run sends nothing (skip_already_sent); still 2 emails total

results.name: Manual resend with {"force":true}
results.expected: Both sprints re-sent; 4 emails total

results.name: Dry run returns a preview without sending or writing state
results.expected: outcome=preview with subject/text; 0 emails; 0 rows
results.actual: outcomes=preview,preview; emails=0; rows=0; subject="[Sprint Health] Payments Sprint 4 | Critical | 29% done | 2026-11-16"

results.name: Concurrency: 5 overlapping executions at once
results.expected: Exactly 1 email per sprint (2 total); 1 sent row per sprint, every other claim marked lost or skipped

results.name: Jira returns HTTP 500 twice on issue search
results.expected: Node retries (3 tries) and the run still succeeds; 2 emails
results.actual: HTTP 200; sent=2; emails=2; Jira calls=12 (incl. 2 failed)

results.name: Jira rate limit (HTTP 429) on sprint lookup
results.expected: Retried after back-off; run succeeds

results.name: Jira down (HTTP 500 on every call)
results.expected: Run fails after retries; no digest; Error Workflow emails the admin
results.actual: HTTP 500; digests=0; admin alert="[Sprint Health] Workflow failure: The service was not able to process your request"

results.name: SMTP rejects the first digest (all 3 attempts)
results.expected: Payments=failed, Mobile=sent; failed row recorded; run errors; admin alerted
results.actual: HTTP 500; rows={"Payments Sprint 4":"failed","Mobile Sprint 9":"sent"}; error="Data command failed: 554 5.7.1 mock: message rejected"; admin alert=yes

results.name: Re-run after SMTP failure retries only the failed digest
results.expected: Payments sent now; Mobile skip_already_sent

results.name: Regression: one transient SMTP rejection must not re-send other digests
results.expected: Payments retried and delivered once; Mobile delivered exactly once (no duplicate)

results.name: Team-managed project: boards of type "simple", one of them Kanban
results.expected: Sprint on the team-managed Scrum board is sent; the Kanban board's HTTP 400 "does not support sprints" is skipped, not an error
results.actual: HTTP 200; outcomes={"Web Sprint 2":"sent"}; kanban board queried (400)=true

results.name: No sprint-capable boards visible to the API user
results.expected: Run fails with a clear "No sprint-capable boards" error; admin alerted; no digest
results.actual: HTTP 500; admin alert="[Sprint Health] Workflow failure: No sprint-capable boards found (types scrum/simple). Check the Jira user can browse the project, or fix Config.boardIds "

results.name: Sprint lookup returns HTTP 500 on every attempt (boards OK)
results.expected: Not mistaken for a Kanban 400: run fails, admin alerted, no digest

results.name: No active sprint on any board
results.expected: status=no_active_sprint; no emails; no rows

results.name: Active sprint with zero issues
results.expected: Digest still sent with health=Empty, 0%
results.actual: Payments Sprint 4: Empty 0% sent; Mobile Sprint 9: Empty 0% sent

results.name: Crash recovery: stale pending claim (2h old) does not block today's digest
results.expected: Stale claim ignored; digest sent

results.name: In-flight protection: fresh pending claim (1 min old) from another run
results.expected: Payments skip_in_flight; no duplicate email for it

results.name: Day-over-day trend from yesterday's snapshot
results.expected: Email shows "+9 pts vs <yesterday>" (29% today vs 20% yesterday)

results.name: No active recipients configured
results.expected: skip_no_recipients; no emails, no claims

results.name: Webhook without the correct token
results.expected: Rejected (HTTP 403), workflow not executed
